risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/agent/**, app.module): rule-knowledge chunk sync (no vectors, D10-194 C; D10-386 ② as B3-08k: the content published-article reader is assembled in app.module and injected into agent; agent never builds another module's reader from a db handle). Writes only app.agent_rule_chunks (BR-AI-02 write scope). Rule tests by an independent Claude (spec 56c01125), implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent (admin lane, f4afc2f4); money review r1 S1 (two interleaved syncs let an old snapshot retire every chunk of a newer version) fixed by serialising the sync per app with a transaction-scoped advisory lock (admin lane r3, committed by the ops lane after the account-3 limit, orchestrator 10-27 19:3x). Admin lane full verify/4 on the test machine exit 0 with the fix.

reviews.note: round 1 (admin lane) fail, S1 interleaved syncs; round 2 (ops lane, full review on the fix commit) pass, one S2: ten concurrent deliveries for one app can hold every worker-pool connection while waiting on the advisory lock (kept for a follow-up)
